scenarios.name: Legitimate SMS
scenarios.description: A single benign one-time-code SMS from a fictional bank to one synthetic subscriber.
scenarios.expected_summary: Stored once (201); SMS analysis unavailable because no model is deployed; indexed as a candidate; no conclusion.

steps.text: [SIMULATED] Your KAVACH demo bank one-time code is 482913. It expires in 10 minutes. Never share it with anyone, including our staff.

scenarios.name: Phishing SMS
scenarios.description: A single synthetic credential-phishing SMS pointing at a reserved .invalid domain.
scenarios.expected_summary: Stored once (201); the phishing label is simulation-only ground truth, not a model output; analysis unavailable.

steps.text: [SIMULATED] Your account will be suspended today. Confirm your card details at http://verify-account.example.invalid/login to avoid closure.

scenarios.name: Legitimate call
scenarios.description: A metadata-only call (no audio) that the scenario author labels benign.
scenarios.expected_summary: Stored once (201); transcription, voice-intent and synthesis are unavailable (no audio, no models).

scenarios.name: Scam-intent call
scenarios.description: A metadata-only call that the scenario author labels as scam intent. Without audio and models nothing distinguishes it from S03 at ingestion.
scenarios.expected_summary: Identical handling to S03: stored, all voice stages unavailable, no risk conclusion.

scenarios.name: Coordinated SMS followed by call
scenarios.description: A phishing SMS and, five minutes later, a scam-intent call to the same synthetic subscriber.
scenarios.expected_summary: Two standalone incidents; both events share one candidate set within the 30-minute window. Candidate proximity is not correlation and establishes no fraud.

steps.text: [SIMULATED] Delivery failed. Pay the redelivery fee at http://parcel-fee.example.invalid/pay within 2 hours or the parcel is returned.

scenarios.name: Unrelated events, different subscribers
scenarios.description: A phishing SMS to one synthetic subscriber and a benign call to another, two minutes apart.
scenarios.expected_summary: Two standalone incidents in separate candidate sets; timing alone never links different subscribers.

steps.text: [SIMULATED] You have won a reward voucher. Claim it at http://reward-claim.example.invalid/now before midnight.

scenarios.name: Out-of-order delivery
scenarios.description: The call (event time two minutes ago) is delivered before the SMS that preceded it (event time eight minutes ago, eight minutes late).
scenarios.expected_summary: Both stored; candidates are ordered by event time, not arrival, so the pair is found regardless of delivery order. The SMS is within the provisional 10-minute lateness allowance.

steps.text: [SIMULATED] Your electricity connection will be cut tonight. Settle the bill at http://power-bill.example.invalid/settle immediately.

scenarios.name: Identical duplicate replay
scenarios.description: The same SMS is submitted twice with the same event ID and identical payload, as a client retry after a lost response would.
scenarios.expected_summary: First 201, then 200 with replayed=true and the original receipt; one event row, one candidate member.

steps.text: [SIMULATED] Your monthly statement is ready to view in the KAVACH demo bank app.

scenarios.name: Conflicting replay with the same event ID
scenarios.description: An SMS is submitted, then its event ID is reused with different text.
scenarios.expected_summary: First 201, then 409 EVENT_ID_CONFLICT; the original event and receipt are unchanged.

steps.text: [SIMULATED] Your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow at the demo clinic.
[SIMULATED] Your appointment is cancelled. Rebook at http://clinic-rebook.example.invalid/pay with a deposit.

scenarios.name: Delayed events and window boundaries
scenarios.description: Events placed around the provisional D05 limits: one older than the 40-minute candidate horizon, one late SMS 36 minutes old, and two calls 32 and 28 minutes after it.
scenarios.expected_summary: All four stored. The 45-minute-old SMS is never indexed; the 36-minute-old SMS is indexed but late; it is a candidate for the call 28 minutes later, not for the one 32 minutes later.

steps.text: [SIMULATED] Reminder: your library books are due back this week.
[SIMULATED] Tax refund pending. Submit your bank login at http://refund-portal.example.invalid/claim today.

scenarios.name: Forged source rejected
scenarios.description: An SMS claims a source other than the one the simulator key is scoped to.

steps.text: [SIMULATED] This message claims to come from a partner feed.

scenarios.name: Unapproved audio reference rejected
scenarios.description: A call names an audio sample that is not in an approved sample manifest (none is approved yet).
scenarios.expected_summary: 422 UNKNOWN_AUDIO_REFERENCE; nothing stored or indexed; no audio is read.
